faqs.a:
The purpose of this article is to protect the public health, safety, and welfare by
               prohibiting the storage of abandoned or inoperable vehicles, or vehicles that contain
               evidence or otherwise have evidentiary value, on public or private property, and by
               setting forth the circumstances under which the city is authorized to impound and
               tow such vehicles. In addition, the purpose of this article is to establish procedures
               for impounding and towing vehicles that are abandoned, inoperable, so defective as
               to pose a safety hazard, contain evidence, or otherwise have evidentiary value, or
               whose impoundment and towing is otherwise authorized.
(
Ord. No. 4384, § 4, 4-15-2013
;
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
